purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt (claims) processing system. It creates monthly insurance claim detail files for rehabilitation/self-pay receipts, including comment editing functionality. It reads indexed receipt files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45 and variants) and produces output detail files with error logging.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

notable_features: Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
REDEFINES used for array-style access to calendar/schedule data
Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, showing mojibake)
Large OCCURS tables for medical procedure and name information
No COMP-3 packed decimal usage despite numeric fields
23 CALL statements indicating modular subprogram architecture
167 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
Error file (RECEERR) for logging processing errors
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project used in Japanese medical practices. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this excerpt, so full data structure details are not visible. The truncation at 16000 chars means the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not shown, but all structural indicators confirm genuine production COBOL.
